Open Data Node

This node of the EOSC Federation publishes open reference datasets for environmental research. Every dataset is available without registration and without authentication, which is a deliberate design decision taken with our funders: there is no authenticated area on this site at all, and therefore no sign in option is offered anywhere in the interface.

Datasets are released under open licences and are governed by the published acceptable use policy. Please cite the persistent identifier of the dataset when you reuse it in published research work.
